$comment: Launcher label boxes. A target is enforced only when status is measured. Every other target is reported as NOT RUN with its reason. Widths are the widest label ink observed on the device; a label whose advance width at the stated font is above boxWidth is shrunk, tightened or truncated by the launcher. See docs/APP_IDENTITY.md.

targets.measuredOn: 2026-11-12, simulator "T3 iPhone Duo" (iPhone-Duo), iOS 27.1, cover panel 466x678 pt @3x; inner panel checked and identical
targets.method: Settings label ink 46.7 pt matches the system font at 12 pt (46.8 pt advance). Box: ink width of the truncated label "NYC-TronInstr..." (85.0 pt). Labels up to 85.7 pt advance render unchanged; "Probe nnnnnniii" (87.6 pt) renders tightened to 82.7 pt ink and "Probe nnnnnnnn" (92.7 pt) loses its space; "NYC-Tron Instruments Demo" (162.0 pt) truncates.

ciCapture.device: iPhone 17 simulator, iOS 26.5, 3 px per pt
ciCapture.note: Built TronLab.app beside copies named "Tron" and "Tron Lab Instruments Demo". "Tron Lab" ink 49.0 pt against a predicted 49.4 pt; the long probe drops its spaces and truncates to "TronLabInstrum..." (86.3 pt of ink). The box stays 85.0 pt from the iOS 27.1 ladder, which is below the 86.3 pt truncated ink seen here. Icon images are the same size; the XCUITest frames differ because they include the label.

targets.measuredOn: 2026-11-12, CI run 43224655686 at 89579c9 (merge 70c5c2f), iPad Pro 11-inch (M5) simulator, iOS 26.5, 2 px per pt
targets.method: "Tron Lab" ink 49.0 pt, the same as on iPhone, so the label uses the same 12 pt font. The long probe truncates to "TronLabInstrum..." with 86.5 pt of ink, one line. targets.method: Unshrunk labels (Calendar, Camera, Clock, Contacts, Files, Gallery, Phone, Search, Settings) match Roboto at 13.9 to 14.5 dp of ink. Box: 167 px / 2.625 = 63.6 dp, the widest ink of any label, truncated ("NYC-Tro...", "Probe nn...") or shrunk. Launcher3 shrinks labels up to about 69.4 dp ("Probe nniiii", "Messaging") before truncating; the check treats any shrink as overflow.

ciCapture.note: Built APK (label 'Tron Lab') beside copies named "Tron" and "Tron Lab Instruments Demo" in the all-apps grid. "Tron Lab" ink 55.2 dp against a predicted 55.3 dp. The long probe truncates to "Tron Lab ..." with 62.1 dp of ink, inside the 63.6 dp box. The Roboto file on this image matches the committed table on all 551 advances (name ID 5 "Version 2.138; 2017").

targets.surface: Windows 11 Start menu pinned and All apps label
targets.reason: Captured, not measured: no Segoe UI advance table is committed (the font is not redistributable), so the check cannot measure Windows. At 89579c9 (run 43224656120) Start shows the packaged example as "Tron WinUI" on one line under Recommended and in the All list, after prepare-host.mjs wrote displayName into Package.appxmanifest. The short and long probe shortcuts (Start Menu .lnk files pointing at notepad.exe) did not appear in the All list, so the neighbours in the capture are system apps (Terminal, Uninstall).

targets.surface: Windows 11 taskbar label and jump-list title
targets.reason: Captured, not measured: no Segoe UI table, and the taskbar has no fixed label box. With labels on, buttons size to their label until the bar is crowded: at 89579c9 (run 43224656120) the "Tron WinUI" button is 113 px wide beside "Untitled - Notepad" (100 px of label ink) and "Default"; at 18d1d4a the older title "NYCTronWindowsExample" was cut to 92 px of ink in a crowded bar. The label is the window title, which prepare-host.mjs now sets to displayName.
